items.title: 52986_Lawrence Brown oral history interview
items.q: that was the only band I played with or made any records with besides Louis Lewis out here.

ctx.x: And all of those were with Quality Serenaders?
Yes, that was the only band I played with or made any records with besides Louis Lewis out here.
I found a reference in a book to "Charlie's Idea": A series of variations on the chords of "Tiger Rag". Was that one of the ones you made with the Quality Serenaders?
